title: JSC Atomredmetzoloto - proposed acquisition of shares in Uranium One Inc

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: JSC Atomredmetzoloto (JSCA) proposed to acquire an interest of up to 19.95% in Uranium One Inc (U1).
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered it unnecessary to define a relevant market.
body_sections.Competition analysis: As the activities of JSCA and U1 did not overlap in Australia, the ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any relevant Australian markets.
